characters.name: Sherlock Holmes
characters.description: The consulting detective investigating the peculiar murder at Birlstone Manor House.

characters.name: Dr. John H. Watson
characters.description: Sherlock Holmes's friend and companion who accompanies him to Birlstone and records the investigation.

characters.name: White Mason
characters.description: A local Sussex detective/specialist with a cool, clear, common-sense approach in charge of the Birlstone investigation.

characters.name: Inspector MacDonald
characters.description: An official police inspector with a noticeable Aberdonian accent working on the case.

characters.name: Sergeant Wilson
characters.description: A tall, formal, melancholy village sergeant in Sussex who held vigil at the crime scene until White Mason took over.

characters.name: Ames
characters.description: The butler at Birlstone Manor House, described as a quaint, gnarled, dried-up old fellow who formerly served Sir Charles Chandos.

characters.name: Mr. John Douglas
characters.description: The victim of the murder at Birlstone Manor House, an American or long-time resident of America bearing a branded mark on his forearm.

characters.name: Mrs. Douglas
characters.description: The wife of Mr. John Douglas who reported hearing the gunshot shortly after her husband left her.

characters.name: Cecil Barker
characters.description: A friend or associate residing at Manor House, described as tall, sunburned, capable-looking, clean-shaved, with masterful eyes.

characters.name: Dr. Wood
characters.description: The medical doctor present at the murder scene who assisted White Mason with examining the body and evidence.

characters.name: Sir Charles Chandos
characters.description: Ames's former employer for ten years before Ames entered Mr. Douglas's service.

locations.name: Birlstone Manor House
locations.description: An ancient Jacobean house of dingy liver-coloured brick, surrounded by a broad water moat with a wooden drawbridge and old-fashioned yew gardens.

locations.name: Birlstone
locations.description: A quaint English village featuring a street flanked by pollarded elms and ancient stone pillars topped by the Capus lion shape.

locations.name: Sussex
locations.description: The English county where the village of Birlstone and the crime scene are located.

relationships.subject: Mr. John Douglas
relationships.explanation: Ames has served as butler to Mr. Douglas for five years since Douglas took Birlstone Manor House.

relationships.subject: Ames
relationships.explanation: Ames worked ten years as butler for Sir Charles Chandos prior to his employment with Mr. Douglas.

relationships.subject: Mrs. Douglas
relationships.explanation: Mrs. Douglas is the wife of the victim, Mr. John Douglas.

relationships.subject: Dr. John H. Watson
relationships.explanation: Dr. Watson accompanies Sherlock Holmes down to Birlstone to assist and record the case.

relationships.subject: White Mason
relationships.explanation: White Mason and Inspector MacDonald cooperate on the official investigation into Mr. Douglas's murder.

relationships.subject: Sergeant Wilson
relationships.explanation: Sergeant Wilson managed the initial police guard at the scene until White Mason arrived to take over.
